name: OCE on Agent Substrate
description: Runs on an OpenClaw Enterprise Agent's gateway: answers each agent turn (HTTP chat included, which ACP bindings do not reach) from the conversation's Agent Substrate actor, created from a golden ActorTemplate on first use and suspended once idle. Reuses the substrate plugin's actor provisioner, router and idle suspender.

atespace.description: atespace the per-conversation actors are created in

template.description: golden ActorTemplate, by bare name in the atespace

actorDomain.description: domain in the Host sent to atenet

ateTokenFile.description: projected ServiceAccount token with audience api.ate-system.svc

egressPolicy.description: protojson EgressPolicy each new actor gets

substrateDist.description: directory of the substrate plugin's compiled modules
